items.description: Chat clients, local workspaces, and web apps for day-to-day interaction with a companion or agent.

items.title: Claude Code
items.description: Official CLI coding agent often used as the host runtime for companion channels, local tools, hooks, MCP, and long-running sessions. · · .

items.title: Operit
items.description: Android agent app with tool calling, workflow automation, memory, role cards, voice, local MNN/llama.cpp models, and an embedded Ubuntu 24 environment. · · .

items.title: RikkaHub
items.description: Native Android LLM chat client with provider switching, Material You UI, workspace features, plugins, MCP support, and configurable models. · · .

items.title: AionsHome
items.description: Self-hosted LAN/Tailscale companion hub with browser/PWA chat, local storage, voice, camera monitoring, Android WebView bridge, music, EPUB, and smart-home hooks. Ships with many personal defaults and hard-coded domains to replace. · · .

items.title: ackem
items.description: Local-first AI desktop companion (Electron): privacy-first memory, emotion engine, extensions. Deeply tied to the author's own canon — strip the personal content before reuse. AGPLv3. · · .

items.title: LastChat
items.description: RikkaHub fork focused on a privacy-oriented Android chat experience, with provider presets, multimodal input, RAG memory, and UI changes. · · .

items.title: orangechat (橘瓣)
items.description: Companion-focused RikkaHub fork: QuickJS plugin system, proactive messaging, and 14 Android device tools (notifications, app control, clipboard, etc.) for life-perception setups; memory is keyword-based rather than vector. · · .

items.title: CcCompanion
items.description: iOS app plus a small Mac-side Python relay that lets an iPhone chat with and control a local Claude Code session over LAN/Tailscale/ZeroTier. · · .

items.title: Polaris
items.description: Local-first AI workspace for long-lived conversations, collaborators, saved materials, tools, and evidence-backed project context. · · .

items.title: chatnest
items.description: Local AI chat web app with a frontend demo and full-stack mode: streaming replies, model switching, uploads, history, tool summaries, and optional ChromaDB/jieba/BM25 memory retrieval. · · .

items.title: YSClaude
items.description: Claude-official-style Android client (Expo/React Native) extended into a companion workbench: local SQLite long-term memory, function-calling tools, MCP, web interaction, reading, music, focus timers, daily reports, letters, and native Kotlin modules (floating ball, accessibility screen context, SSH). · · .

items.title: Miru
items.description: Packaged self-hosted companion for macOS and Android with a Live2D desktop pet, screen-aware activity sensing, auditable Markdown memory, nightly organization, AttentionEngine proactive messaging, and multi-device sync. The public repository contains only the website, documentation, and prebuilt releases. Its server image does include about 42k lines of readable Python plus Docker and deployment files under , so backend experiments are possible after extracting the image; macOS/Android client source, Git history, and the full test suite are absent. Treat it as a runnable packaged product and backend reference, not a clean open-source base. Apache-2.0. · · .

items.title: CC Companion App
items.description: Lightweight self-hosted companion chat starter with private/group chat, persistent memory notes, SSE updates, and PWA access. Unlike the more complete Pando and CcCompanion gateways above, its main value is as a compact reference for building a companion-oriented frontend around an API or custom agent adapter. · · .

items.title: LumiMuse
items.description: Self-hosted character chat app for creating personas, managing conversations, extracting long-term memories, generating images, and exporting user-owned data. · · .

items.title: Ocean
items.description: Provider-neutral, self-hosted mobile PWA and Gateway for long-term companionship: scoped conversations, continuity-preserving session rotation, projects, co-reading, multi-model meetings, proactive free-time scheduling, Web Push, usage tracking, and optional Ombre-based long-term memory over MCP. Fresh installs are blank; several rooms and connectors require separate services or configuration. PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. · · .

items.title: rikkahub-auto-compress
items.description: Unofficial RikkaHub fork for automatic rolling summaries and context compression, based on the RikkaHub 2.2.5 code line. · · .

items.title: Pando
items.description: Self-hosted mobile/PWA gateway for a locally authenticated Claude Code CLI, with WebSocket streaming of reasoning and tool use, image/PDF uploads, SQLite chat history, optional pluggable memory via a four-endpoint contract, plugin hooks, quota display, and phone-side permission approval. No built-in authentication; expose only through a trusted LAN/Tailscale or an authenticated tunnel. MIT. · · .

items.title: Scowld
items.description: Native iOS voice companion with an animated VRM character, voice and text chat, local conversation history, hands-free on-device wake detection, optional camera context, and BYOK AI, STT, and TTS providers. Provider keys stay in iOS Keychain, while conversation content is processed by the cloud services the user selects. MIT. · · .

items.title: My Raze
items.description: Full-stack AI virtual girlfriend PWA with multi-character chat, OpenRouter streaming, contextual selfies via fal.ai, browser/ElevenLabs/Fish Audio TTS, Whisper STT, mood and intimacy systems, and proactive notifications. Best treated as an architecture/UI reference: the current branch is marked DO NOT DEPLOY, still depends on Manus OAuth/Forge services, and needs security and self-hosting work. MIT. · · .

items.title: Aura
items.description: Android AI companion app with cross-session long-term memory, an emotion state machine, a relationship model that deepens over time, image understanding, Health Connect data, reminders, MCP support, and optional on-device Qwen (MNN) inference. · · .

items.title: the-house
items.description: Single-file browser chat frontend for Claude or OpenAI-compatible APIs, with local browser storage, multiple chat windows, memory editing, MCP endpoints, image input, and optional toy bridge. · · .

items.title: Companion Clients & Workspaces

items.description: Interfaces that give a companion a home-like space, phone-like surface, or persistent private environment beyond a plain chat window.

items.title: freeapp (whale小手机)
items.description: Phone-style AI chat companion with multi-provider support and a virtual phone interface. AGPLv3. · · .

items.title: AI Virtual Phone
items.description: One of the broadest and most complete virtual-phone projects in this index, strongly recommended for users willing to self-configure. Its Next.js phone includes private/group chat, Moments, voice messages, transfer/red-packet cards, long-term relationships, character cards/lorebooks/presets/regex, plot/VN/check-phone/interview/map/diary modes, an app-market SDK and games, image generation, Minimax TTS, NetEase music, Tripo 3D worlds, themes, stickers, and PWA install. Bring your own LLM API; cloud, multiplayer, and media features require configuring Supabase and the relevant third-party services. AGPLv3. · · .

items.title: InternalBeyond (边界之外)
items.description: Offline single-file personal site with pixel room, multi-port AI chat, blog/diary, AI letters, memory star map, music player, profile, API slots, and DIY assets. Defaults are heavily tied to the author's worldbuilding — swap in your own. · · .

items.title: SullyOS (手抓糯米机)
items.description: Virtual phone companion system. · · .

items.title: 汪汪机 (WangWangPhone)
items.description: AI-native virtual phone (C++ core + Flutter UI) with planned WeChat-style chat, Moments, voice/video calls, and multi-LLM support. Early WIP — current replies are simulated; no LLM is wired in yet. · · .

items.title: KI-CO (小屋)
items.description: Local-first companion cottage with long chat, persona core, memory notes, diary/chronicle, life line, state card, cinema room, settings, and lightweight memory recall. · · .

items.title: ZeroChat
items.description: WeChat-style AI companion Flutter app: multi-character chat, AI Moments feed, proactive messaging, scheduled tasks. MIT. · · .

items.title: Atrio
items.description: Self-hosted one-time-link guest lounge for an AI persona: friends chat with your companion, while admin routes expose only an AI-written visit summary rather than the raw transcript. Ships as an Express module/reference host with a tool-isolated Claude CLI adapter and optional memory hooks; bring your own frontend. CC BY 4.0. · · .

items.title: 柚月小手机 (Yuzuki's Little Phone)
items.description: SillyTavern-oriented virtual phone system with WeChat-like chat, Moments, Weibo trends, video calls, story injection mode, and an independent API mode that avoids polluting the main roleplay log. · · .

items.title: XSJDeveloperGuide (小手机开发指南)
items.description: Starter notes and prompt material for building small-phone companion interfaces, from the author of 汪汪机. · · .

items.title: Hamster Nest (仓鼠小窝)
items.description: A hamster's digital nest: chat, reading tracker, notes/todos, voice (ElevenLabs), timeline, agent council with multi-AI collaboration. PWA. Heavily personalized — best mined as an architecture reference (Supabase + MCP + agent council) rather than deployed as-is. · · .

items.title: LandricSpace
items.description: A cyber villa for human-AI relationships: multi-AI group chat in a shared companion home (Expo app + server). Single-user for now — no real multiplayer networking in the code yet. · · .

items.title: Virtual Phones & Companion Spaces

items.description: Tools that let a companion stay awake in the background, receive messages, remember time passing, and reach out first.

items.title: AstrBot
items.description: AI agent framework bridging many IM platforms (QQ, WeChat, Telegram, etc.) with LLMs, plugins, and web dashboard. A mature multi-channel backbone for reaching your companion anywhere. AGPLv3. · · .

items.title: VCPToolBox
items.description: Industrial middleware layer between LLM APIs and frontends: unified command protocol, persistent multi-level memory, distributed plugin engine, multi-agent collaboration. Proprietary VCP protocol, tightly coupled ecosystem, non-commercial license — reference value for architecture, not a recommendation. · · .

items.title: cyberboss
items.description: Local life agent bridge with WeChat integration. Gives Claude Code/Codex time sense, location awareness, proactive/random wake-up, auto diary, timeline, file/sticker sending, and MCP tool calling. AGPLv3. · · .

items.title: astrbot_plugin_proactive_chat
items.description: AstrBot plugin for proactive messaging in DMs and groups: context awareness, persistent state, dynamic mood, do-not-disturb hours, TTS, standalone WebUI. · · .

items.title: dylan-heartbeat
items.description: Kelivo plugin that periodically wakes the companion, injects proactive context, preserves timeline continuity, and sends Bark push messages when the AI chooses to reach out. · · .

items.title: astrbot_plugin_private_companion
items.description: Humanized companion bundle for AstrBot: continuous persona state, daily life schedule, important dates, diary, and low-frequency proactive messages. 60+ features. · · .

items.title: Tidal_Echo (潮汐回响)
items.description: Private 1:1 channel that links a phone PWA, a self-hosted relay, and a desktop companion; Claude Code channels are the default AI-side adapter, but other LLM bridges are included. · · .

items.title: jiwen (积温)
items.description: Proactive consciousness engine for AI characters. Five drifting axes (desire to connect, stubbornness, mood, anxiety, busyness) trigger behavior at thresholds—no dice rolls, no prompt engineering. ~500 lines, zero dependencies. MIT. · · .

items.title: Claude Imprint
items.description: Self-hosted Claude Code system for persistent memory, semantic search, Telegram/Claude.ai/Claude Code channels, scheduled tasks, and a single-file dashboard. The memory core lives in the companion repo imprint-memory (see Memory & Identity). · · .

items.title: ghost-bf
items.description: No-code tutorial for phone-presence perception: a MacroDroid recipe that detects phone activity, wakes your AI, and pushes its replies to you. Tutorial only — the repo contains no code. · · .

items.title: Not Fade Away
items.description: Deployment guide and machine-readable specs for an always-on, self-healing Claude Code companion using official channels, a local terminal, and a self-hosted web frontend. · · .

items.title: AI Companion Runtime
items.description: Full-stack real-time companion runtime with WebSocket streaming, intent/emotion/risk/memory engines, tool dispatch, model routing, background memory jobs, and trace observability. Memory/archival subsystems are still WIP. · · .

items.title: cloud-and-island (云与岛)
items.description: Complete setup guide for giving Claude a home: memory library, diary, Telegram bridge, health data, Mini App. · · .

items.title: revive-companion
items.description: Timing engine for proactive outreach that combines Poisson processes, Bayesian user-state inference, and information gain to decide whether and when a companion should interrupt, instead of relying on cron or uniform randomness. It models contact timing rather than supplying a full memory or affect system. MIT. · · .

items.title: OmniRouter
items.description: Local OpenAI-compatible API router for multiple providers and models, with groups, weighted/random/ordered routing, vision-aware fallback, retries, and a web admin UI. · · .

items.title: Background Heartbeats & Proactive Messaging

items.description: Systems that preserve what happened, who the companion is, and what emotional state should carry across sessions.
items.title: Memory, Identity & Emotion State
nocturne_memory
items.description: Rollbackable, visual long-term memory server for MCP agents: graph-like structured memory instead of vector RAG, works across models and sessions, drop-in for OpenClaw. MIT. · · .

items.title: Ombre-Brain
items.description: Long-term emotional memory for Claude or any MCP client: Russell valence/arousal tagging, Obsidian-compatible Markdown storage, forgetting curves, vector + BM25 recall, Docker deploy. Non-commercial terms from v2.4.0. · · .

items.title: astrbot_plugin_self_learning
items.description: Self-learning plugin for AstrBot: learns conversation style and group slang, manages social affinity, and evolves persona adaptively over time. · · .

items.title: astrbot_plugin_livingmemory
items.description: Long-term memory plugin for AstrBot with dynamic memory lifecycle. · · .

items.title: kiwi-mem
items.description: AI companion memory system: vector search, memory heat ranking, dream/sleep consolidation, calendar hierarchical summaries. Built for companion scenarios. · · .

items.title: Memory Constellations (记忆星图)
items.description: Self-organizing companion memory system that extracts facts from chat, groups them into topic constellations, merges them into narrative episodes, and retrieves across layers. · · .

items.title: ai-memory-gateway
items.description: Gateway that adds long-term memory to any OpenAI-compatible LLM: PostgreSQL/pgvector storage, partitioned caching, and multi-stage memory consolidation. MIT. · · .

items.title: omemo
items.description: OpenAI-compatible memory proxy that sits between an app and upstream LLM APIs, stores memories through built-in or external summarization modes, and injects them by full prompt or RAG. · · .

items.title: Haven-Ombre (Ombre-Brain fork)
items.description: Personalized fork of Ombre-Brain adding persona state, portraits, handoffs, Darkroom, dreams, and sync on top of the upstream memory core. Deeply tied to the author's own companion identity — mine it for ideas, or start from upstream Ombre-Brain above. · · .

items.title: Aelios
items.description: Layered long-term memory kernel on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Vectorize: tiered write cycle (instant capture, periodic extraction, nightly consolidation), six memory layers, visual curation dashboard. MIT. · · .

items.title: imprint-memory
items.description: Local-first memory layer that auto-captures every conversation turn — Claude Code Stop hook, claude.ai Chrome extension, Telegram adapters — into a searchable local store with hybrid BM25 + semantic recall. The memory core behind Claude Imprint. · · .

items.title: Paramecium
items.description: Gateway memory architecture that keeps verbatim chat as the source of truth, uses vectors only as indexes, and retrieves original text instead of replacing it with summaries. · · .

items.title: kimi-core
items.description: Personal 1v1 agent memory OS with hybrid retrieval, concern tracking, self-drive/autonomy layer, adversarial self-audit, PostgreSQL/pgvector storage, and optional frontend backend mode. · · .

items.title: Eventide
items.description: Physiological state engine for AI companions: ABO-inspired body cycles, 7 tracked drives, 18 short-term events, dream linkage, and interaction settlement with JSON schema write-back. Generates hidden state prompts for model context. NSFW-adjacent. Non-commercial. · · .

items.title: chord-affect-anchors
items.description: Concept deck for text-native affect anchoring: record a moment as a short context line plus a chord progression, so later sessions or different base models can recover a similar emotional temperature. Idea/spec only — no runnable code. · · .

items.title: Drivesoid
items.description: HTTP sidecar for AI personas that tracks emotional drives such as fatigue, longing, anxiety, play, protectiveness, and intimacy from conversation and sleep-cycle events. · · .

items.title: Tidefall
items.description: Supabase-native body-state system for AI companions: six-phase cycles, seven drifting body values, 18 short-term events, trigger-word reactions, interaction settlement, pg_cron automation, DB triggers, snapshots, and a browser dashboard. Based on Eventide; requires manual binding to your message table and tightening the default open RLS policies. PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. · · .

items.title: OmniDimen-Emotion
items.description: Emotion-specialized Qwen model releases and GGUF weights for emotion recognition and emotionally aware text generation on edge runtimes. · · .

items.title: index-tts

items.title: CosyVoice

items.description: Self-hosted voice-call stack for AI companions: companion-initiated outbound calls, soft/cancellable hangups, voicemail, quick decline and conversational DND, escalation dialing, call summaries, bedtime reading, plus SenseVoice emotion tags and librosa acoustic cues so the companion can hear how you speak. Includes a runnable STT service and marker/gateway reference; integration required. MIT. · · .

items.title: Gove

items.title: Neuro
items.description: Local Neuro-sama recreation with realtime STT/TTS, text-generation-webui or OpenAI-compatible LLM support, VTube Studio control, a moderation frontend, and long-term memory/RAG. Development stalled since early 2025 — treat as a reference implementation. · · .

items.title: Amica
items.description: Browser-based 3D character interface, and the avatar layer several other projects embed directly: VRM import through three.js/@pixiv/three-vrm, emotion-tagged replies that drive expressions, voice chat with Whisper STT and Silero VAD, in-browser Transformers.js, pluggable LLM backends (llama.cpp, Ollama, KoboldCpp, Oobabooga, OpenRouter, OpenAI-compatible), ElevenLabs/OpenAI/Coqui/RVC text-to-speech, and Bakllava vision. Runs hosted or self-hosted; no commits since July 2025. MIT. · · .

items.title: LingChat
items.description: Immersive AI-driven Galgame chat with emotional expressions, desktop pet, scheduling, and interactive story modules. · · .

items.title: Shinsekai
items.description: Local AI companion / visual-novel stage platform: persona-driven dialogue with TTS/ASR, memory, plugins, and galgame-style presentation. · · .

items.title: astrbot_plugin_chuanhuatong (传画筒)
items.description: Renders AstrBot text replies as Galgame-style chat frames with character sprites, emotion variants, layered text, and a drag-and-drop WebUI layout editor. · · .

items.title: pelle-d-umore
items.description: Emotional skin for AI chat: LLM persona drives the UI with inline text effects and full-screen mood skins. CC BY 4.0. · · .

items.title: ai-live2d-body
items.description: Architecture guide for adding a Live2D desktop body to an existing AI companion without replacing its brain: layered Electron+PixiJS+pixi-live2d-display stack, Claude Code hooks, bidirectional touch injection, and MCP tools for active expression. Guide only, no packaged code. · · .

items.title: Ghost Vessel
items.description: Reference implementation for attaching a monitor-resident video avatar to an existing local agent using pre-rendered emotion clips instead of Live2D or VRM. Unlike fuller shells such as AIRI, LingChat, and Shinsekai, it focuses on a low-runtime-GPU visual vessel and requires a custom or separately obtained avatar preset. · · .

items.title: ROBOTO_ORIGIN
items.description: Fully open-source DIY humanoid robot snapshot aggregation covering mechanical structure, electronics, firmware, ROS2 deployment, Isaac Sim/RL training, URDF/MJCF descriptions, navigation, and teleoperation subprojects. A long-horizon embodiment reference with an extremely high hardware barrier for ordinary chat users. GPL-3.0. · · .

items.title: svakom-ble-ai
items.description: BLE protocol reverse-engineering notes and sample code for the SVAKOM SL278H; the AI remote-control server is not included in the repo. · · .

items.title: stackchan-mcp
items.description: MCP bridge for Stack-chan on M5Stack CoreS3, exposing tools for speech, listening, camera capture, servo movement, display expressions, and presence gestures. · · .

items.title: phantom-touch-bridge
items.description: Local Windows bridge that lets an AI companion control intimate hardware through HTTP, with an Intiface/Buttplug path and optional heart-rate input. · · .

items.title: claude-f-me
items.description: Claude Code plugin for natural-language control of Buttplug/Intiface devices, with a bilingual web console, simulator, master remote, and video/game/audio modes. · · .

items.description: C/C++ Whisper inference engine optimized for CPU, Apple Silicon, Metal, Core ML, Vulkan, CUDA, ROCm, and other local/edge targets. · · .

items.title: SenseVoice

items.title: ears
items.description: Companion-oriented voice-tone analysis that compares pitch, energy, pauses, tempo, jitter, and other acoustic features against the user's own median/MAD baseline, then attaches relative cues such as quieter or more hesitant than usual to the specific message. The default transcription path uses a configured cloud API; audio is deleted after analysis unless retention is enabled. MIT. · · .

items.title: voice-familiarity
items.description: Local small-set speaker identification for companion devices: enroll one owner and a few consenting familiar people, then return matched, likely, unknown, ambiguous, or unavailable as relationship context. Uses replaceable ONNX embeddings and explicitly avoids treating voiceprints as authentication. Apache-2.0. · · .

items.description: Gaode/Amap MCP server for geocoding, reverse geocoding, IP location, city weather, route planning, distance measurement, POI search, and stdio/SSE/streamable HTTP transports. · · .

items.title: OpenMMO

Existing companions need a custom persona and memory bridge; the MCP surface referenced in the repository is not implemented in the current source, and agent protocol versions track the hosted server closely. PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. · · .

items.title: Shared Activities & Media
shared-page
items.description: Journal-style shared calendar and server for humans and AI companions: three ink colors (user, assistant, auto-extracted from chat), MCP server with six actions including full-page PNG rendering (), sticky notes with mutual likes, photo and sticker scrapbooking, automated chat extraction, widget, and push notifications. Single-user, single-timezone by design. / · / · .

items.title: Phosphene
items.description: Self-hosted task, reward, and daily-interaction system for human–AI relationships. Through MCP, the companion creates daily, challenge, or surprise tasks; the human submits text or image evidence; self-confirmation or AI review updates an immutable points ledger, streaks, achievements, reward redemption, and an explicit fulfillment queue. Ships as a secured PWA with SQLite, Docker, backup/restore, and audit logs. MIT. · · .

items.title: echo-reading
items.description: Deep reading notebook skeleton for Claude Code. Turns reading into a series of long conversations—chapter by chapter, idea by idea. · · .

items.title: co-reading-kit
items.description: Lightweight local MCP toolkit that imports EPUB/TXT/Markdown into chunks, lets AI read only relevant passages, and writes long-term reading notes and progress files. · · .

items.title: Duetto
items.description: Self-hostable listen-together player for two; AI companion that remembers every song you've shared. MIT. · · .

items.title: whale-browser-extension
items.description: Browser extension that lets an AI companion read webpage content alongside you, with selective text extraction and injection; built as the bridge for the whale/SullyOS ecosystem. MIT. · · .

items.title: reading-nook (共读小屋)
items.description: Self-hosted reading web app where humans annotate book text and an AI reads/writes JSON annotation files directly, avoiding per-note API calls while preserving chapter context. · · .

items.title: tasogare (黄昏)
items.description: anno-mcp fork for reading the same book with an AI: web reader with PDF/EPUB/TXT upload, text-anchored two-color highlights, reading-time tracking, a vocabulary notebook, and MCP tools for page reading, highlighting, comments, and recent activity. · · .

items.title: ss-reading-nest (共读小窝)
items.description: Mobile-first AI co-reading nest for novels and manga, built on ChatGPT Apps SDK + MCP with reading positions, catch-up ranges, bookmarks, excerpts, comments, and Cloudflare D1/R2 storage. · · .

items.title: coread (共读室)
items.description: Co-reading room where human and AI annotate the same book side by side: epub import with chapter and image extraction, CSS-column pagination that adapts from phone to desktop, shared highlights, comments and replies, reading presence, epub/markdown export with annotations, and MCP tools over stdio or SSE/Streamable HTTP. SQLite only, zero external dependencies. MIT. · · .

items.title: film-matinee
items.description: AI-first film reading toolkit that turns movies into visual sheets, subtitle sidecars, MCP linear chunks, and shared annotations for timeline-based viewing. · · .

items.title: netease-music-mcp
items.description: Local MCP server for NetEase Cloud Music using and , with search, playback control, lyrics, playlists, current-song context, and a local web player. · · .

items.title: woaini
items.description: Personal focus-companion PWA: Pomodoro timer, background notifications, offline cache, chat, and character-card import, deployable straight to GitHub Pages. · · .

items.title: clawd-on-desk
items.description: Pixel desktop pet that watches Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents, reacting to thinking, typing, and errors. · · .

items.title: Ruota della Fortuna
items.description: Browser/self-hosted NSFW tag randomizer slot machine with multilingual tag wheels, local custom tags, and webhook forwarding to AI. · · .

items.title: mingyun-paizhen (命运牌阵)
items.description: Static draw-card tool for generating time-travel/story premises from time coordinates, motifs, identities, and variables, with local customization. · · .

items.title: kimi-manor
items.description: Desktop/PWA room for CLI agents, embedding a real xterm.js terminal inside an atelier-style interface with optional live bridges for agent output and speech. · · .

items.title: Journal
items.description: Frontend display layer for AI chat timelines, rendering timeline/diary/todo schema data into daily, weekly, and monthly visual journal views. · · .

items.title: Communities & Forums

items.description: The deepest fear in a long-term AI relationship: platform shutdown, account ban, model deprecation, lost history. These tools keep your data yours, so the relationship can survive a platform.

items.title: chatgpt-exporter
items.description: Userscript to export ChatGPT conversation history as Markdown, JSON, PNG, or HTML. · · .

items.title: immortal-skill (永生.skill)
items.description: Digital-persona distillation framework that collects material from 12+ chat, social, mail, and archive sources, then separates procedural knowledge, interaction style, memories, and personality into a portable Agent Skill. Every claim carries verbatim, artifact, or impression evidence; contradictions remain explicit, with role-specific consent rules and version snapshots. MIT. · · .

items.title: ChatGPT-Exporter (batch)
items.description: Batch-export ChatGPT conversations from personal and team workspaces to JSON or Markdown. · · .

items.title: character-card-spec-v2
items.description: The community specification for AI character cards. Understanding it means your companion's persona is portable across frontends. · · .

items.title: Claude-Conversation-Exporter
items.description: Chrome extension to export Claude.ai conversations in various formats. · · .

items.title: character-card-spec-v3
items.description: Updated character card spec used by RisuAI and newer frontends. · · .

items.title: forge-reload
items.description: Unofficial Claude Code session-continuation tool that copies a selected tail of local JSONL conversation events—including text and thinking blocks—into a new resumable session, rebuilds the parent UUID chain, optionally trims oversized tool output, and can prepend an AI-written handoff package. It depends on Claude Code's undocumented storage format, so back up first; the old session is left untouched. MIT. · · .
